study.question: After both single-component buy-context updates underperformed the native sum, does retaining both signed components with a predeclared two-to-one balance improve click AUC, and does native field-norm restoration change that conclusion?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: native buy context N=R+P achieved click AUC0.6685318110053072; keeping only its product-axis parallel A or orthogonal T component at native field norm yielded0.6683520250837824 and0.6677342631928505. Raw endpoints also lost. Thus component deletion was unsuccessful; it does not establish that native relative weights are optimal. Provisional mechanism: both components may carry complementary training signals, while less extreme rebalancing could retain useful cross-branch information. Test Uo=A+0.5T and Ua=0.5A+T in a component-by-norm factorial. Useful rebalancing requires exceeding the native comparator, not merely recovering part of a deletion loss. No current result establishes this mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Direct code parent inspected and SHA256 verified. Retains its fieldwise product-axis decomposition, common relative support gate, FP32 geometry and source ownership; replaces zeroing either component by fixed half attenuation and computes both resulting norm policies. The local contribution is a diagnostic extension, not a new unified architecture.

Native local empirical comparator at identical learned capacity and forward. New backward rebalances components without reversing their native signs; retain the archived native and reflection outcomes rather than interpreting deletion as refutation.

Primary archived text inspected at lines264-283: target-conditioned local activation uses unnormalized history pooling. That pooling and adapted Dice/towers remain inherited. The proposed change concerns a task-specific training cotangent in a later compressed-history adapter, not original DIN reproduction or a priority claim.

Inspected pinned constructor and forward at git90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d; benchmark uses categorical/task/sequence hubs and gated exchanges. Current model retains inherited masked compression and task adapters; this change only rebalances a buy-specific backward signal and implements no INFNet hub mechanism. Original INFNet paper is not audited here; originality relative to gradient-surgery literature is unverified.

predictions: If restoration of a missing complementary component is useful, half_orthogonal_restored should exceed g0-r0076-parallel_restored, and half_parallel_restored should exceed g0-r0076-orthogonal_restored. This is graded recovery evidence only; neither comparison establishes improvement over native.

Useful rebalancing predicts at least one restored mixture exceeds native click AUC0.6685318110053072 at unchanged capacity and justified measured training cost. At native field norm, mixture direction versus native direction is the intended local contrast.

If excessive magnitude explains differences, raw versus restored arms at the same mixture direction will differ systematically; a benefit restricted to raw arms cannot establish a native-norm direction advantage.

Forward outputs, buffers and non-context parameter gradients at an identical state/input should agree across modes; only the buy branch contribution to context embedding gradients may change. Actual trajectories are expected to diverge after updates.

All task metrics and pre-existing history-length slices must be reported. A click gain may coexist with auxiliary degradation; auxiliary mean is not the selection metric. Slice differences are exploratory with inherited counts and no claim of new independent evidence.
falsifiers: If neither partial restored update exceeds the native comparator, useful native-norm rebalancing is unsupported for the tested half coefficient; do not promote a recovered deletion loss into a success.
If partial arms fail to improve over their corresponding deletion endpoints, the simple partial-retention explanation is unsupported in this implementation.

If improvements appear only under raw shrinkage, attribute any candidate benefit provisionally to a direction/magnitude interaction and require a matched native-direction shrinkage control before a directional claim.

Any forward, buffer, learned-state, input-visibility, non-context gradient-ownership or native-mode parity mismatch invalidates the intended contrast; fix it before training and retain costs of any failed checks.
If supported fields are absent or numerically negligible, the component hypothesis is not identified. Do not interpret native fallback as a successful intervention.

observations: DIN click AUC0.6555440824200336 is the reproducible host reference. The imported bests are0.660646940486458 and0.660163362657485. The inherited native-orientation model is0.6685318110053072; this separation reflects many earlier changes, not the proposed partial-gradient intervention.

The initial compressed task query model g0-r0006-compressed_task0.6591942389399411 lost to event-task0.660163362657485; anchored task query g0-r0007-anchored_task_query0.6604926719194907 still did not beat the stronger imported source. Compression plus task conditioning alone was unsuccessful in those implementations.

Ordinal/block match detail and later block interaction branches were adopted along the lineage; raw trajectory summaries do not independently establish every inherited mechanism. g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer0.6685268680116033 and blocked0.6678681338736719 provide a closer local forward/gradient ownership contrast than comparing only with DIN.

Buy-isolated summary restored and native g0-r0071-buy_isolated_restored/g0-r0071-buy_isolated_native both yielded0.6680376118468522. This is counterevidence to a standalone buy summary-direct-transfer explanation; current shared-learning and clipping interactions remain unresolved.

The restored buy-summary parent differs from the fully native summary branch by only0.0000049429937039 click AUC. Deterministic bridge matches do not establish robust improvement of that selected summary intervention.

Recent endpoint trials all completed successfully but failed to beat native: parallel_restored0.6683520250837824, orthogonal_restored0.6677342631928505, parallel_raw0.6682539335350056, orthogonal_raw0.6680525228369655. These are scientific negative findings, not execution failures.

Orthogonal reflection0.6684957032668137 was close to native while parallel reflection0.6678734802477688 was lower. This asymmetry motivates the reciprocal partial attenuations but does not prove that either component is semantically causal.

No failed execution is listed in the supplied trajectory index and previous_runtime_error is null. This statement is limited to the supplied record, not a claim that omitted global history contains no failures.
